scope: Actual C mode getter/memory and SDK-typed 16-byte HVX parameters; all log modes and short-circuit transitions, dual enable flags/handle offsets, low-halfword 244-byte cap, full-word connection/flag registers, lookup result/null, client mutation, SVC return/length update and saved registers/stack
limitations: Actual registry init/CONNECTED/DISCONNECTED/reconnect events execute before BAE8/lookup; notification/storage pools remain fixtures, error/log and SVC174 responses remain intercepted;  SVC174 is observed and answered by a deterministic hook, not a SoftDevice execution.
The service prefix is only a read view; complete object extent, initialization and callback configuration remain unproven.
Fault addresses are compared without access-width identity; physical BLE transmission, original instructions and whole-image linking remain open.
